text: Over the last 30 days, visitors have noted issues related to food quality and wait times more frequently than other aspects of their experience. windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days show consistent concerns about the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and limited menu availability, with some noting that the kitchen was often backed up or only offering grab-and-go options late in the day. Many found the food quality below expectations, describing portions as small and prices as high relative to the value received. There were also complaints about the menu choices and preparation, including specific dishes that did not meet taste or quality standards. Service issues related to ordering and pricing were mentioned but less frequently than food-related concerns.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many guests found the menu limited, overpriced, and of inconsistent quality, with several mentioning long wait times and kitchen delays that affected their ability to order. Portions were often described as small relative to the cost, and some specific dishes did not meet expectations. While the library itself received positive remarks, the cafe’s food quality, pricing, and service logistics were the main sources of dissatisfaction. Addressing these concerns could improve the overall visitor experience.
